title: Master Hunter 3D
description: Track fast-moving targets across sunlit low-poly wilderness ranges, steady your aim, and land pinpoint shots before time runs out.
controls: Hold and drag to move your aiming reticle onto moving targets, then release to fire.

zh-CN.title: 狩猎高手
zh-CN.description: 明快 3D 低多边形荒野狙击狩猎：在阳光林地里预判移动目标走位，稳准瞄准一击命中刷新高分纪录！
zh-CN.controls: 按住屏幕拖动准星锁定移动目标，找准提前量松手射击完成狩猎任务。
